digest.component_or_area: LLM model selection and fallback routing
propositions: A class with no fallback array builds an unwrapped model, preserving current behavior
A class with fallback array builds a FallbackModel whose default is the primary entry and fallbacks are inline model configs with the same shape as a slot
An error classified in _RETRYABLE or CHANGE_PROVIDER_OR_MODEL triggers fallback; errors outside that set (e.g., 401/403, context-length errors) propagate without failover
Capabilities are computed as the conservative intersection across all resolved candidates (primary plus all fallbacks) before the FallbackModel wrapper is constructed
The ran_model field in provider_provenance is populated from ModelResponse.model_name, not from FallbackModel.model_name, to correctly attest which candidate actually answered

The FallbackModel must be entered and exited as an async context manager so that pydantic-ai's sub-model providers are properly lifecycle-managed while rebar-created transports remain on ProviderSession._closeables
